description: The repository record describes MODIS vegetation-index time series used to map irrigated areas in northeastern Brazil, with weaker performance in wetter regions. The cited provider is Andre Keiiti Ide; Gustavo Macedo de Mello Baptista (via Figshare). The analysis covers northeastern Brazilian basins for 2006 to 2015. Access starts from the cited provider page or document; no underlying files were retrieved. Listed formats are Publication metadata. The inspected metadata names the CC BY 4.0 licence. The public information is free to read; underlying resource charges remain unverified. The repository entry documents a study. Separate reusable map files were not established, and the method reports weaker performance in wetter regions. For infrastructure simulation, it can inform irrigation-demand or agricultural water-management scenarios.
